snippet.title: Sinking Iron - Iron Lung meets FNAF in this thalassophobia and megalophobia-filled game!
snippet.description:
Download for free on itch.io https://lixiangames.itch.io/sinking-iron?ac=qfCyYFQF-yt A strong submarine earthquake caught the attention of an amateur diver and his apprentice.

They were close by when the incident happened and decided to investigate before officials arrived.

You are the apprentice. Good luck.
